notes.title: [WILD WEST: THE LAST COWBOY] Balance Patch Progress News
notes.content: [p]Hello, fellow gunslingers![/p][p]This is the "The Wild West" development team.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we're updating you on the latest balance patch progress.[/p][p][/p][p]We're working on a balance patch to ensure each character's unique charm and fighting style shines even more on the battlefield.[/p][p]This patch goes beyond simple numerical adjustments; we've thoroughly analyzed each character's strengths and weaknesses through internal test footage and developer match simulations.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🔥 Maxwell's cool-headed command of the battlefield[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/690204867756eba575c5792a5e8c3be7aee7b958.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]⚡ Jane's unexpected speed that cuts through the wind[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/69182de8794d38d2aaa5d93a12e8f231aad0e884.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]💥 Howard's tenacious vitality, a powerful blow that blocks enemy attacks[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/f1dd28727ca106e0eec50ade080043351c8fdee9.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]🌌 Jack's agile counterattack that seeps in like a shadow[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/76eaf4ae98a28a79ea42aac030e59e16380f075e.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]As such, we're doing our best to create a balanced battlefield environment where each character's unique personality lives and breathes.[/p][p][/p][p]🔧Main Progression[/p][p]Developers personally select characters and test them in various ways, including 1v1 and team battles.[/p][p]Gameplay is recorded on video to analyze each character's strengths, weaknesses, and utilization.[/p][p]If a particular character is too strong or too weak, their stats and skills are fine-tuned.[/p][p][/p][p]Our goal is to ensure that all players can enjoy fair yet unique combat, regardless of their character choice.[/p][p]We'll be releasing internal test footage along with more specific patch notes soon, so please look forward to it! 🎥[/p][p][/p][p]We look forward to your interest and feedback on our quest to create a fairer and more realistic Western battlefield.[/p][p]Your legend begins now.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [WILD WEST: THE LAST COWBOY] Character & Gun Skin Combination Introduction Part3
notes.content: [p]Hello, gunfighters![/p][p]Summer has arrived in the wilderness.[/p][p]Today, we're introducing the summer skin \[Summer Haze].[/p][p][/p][p]Now that the wind is hotter and the gunfire is more vibrant,[/p][p]we'll give you a special experience of coloring the battlefield like a festival with character & gun skin combinations that each harmonize with the unique personality and summer mood.[/p][p]Check out these four combinations unfolding under the dazzling sun![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/0afc7a35fd3357e54c708277616d73ff1f08198a.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔥Tropical cool duelist x Shark Barrel revolver with shark fury[/h3][p]"Swift hands hidden under his Hawaiian shirt. His summer begins like a festival, but ends in a duel."[/p][p]He's light on his feet like a tropical festival, but he can easily take down careful foes.[/p][p][/p][p]"A shark-shaped high-pressure revolver. Sharp as water, its firing sensation is powerful!"[/p][p]His quick-handling style, hidden behind his laid-back appearance, combined with his powerful revolver, makes him even more menacing.[/p][p][/p][p]🦈Matching Point:[/p][p]Approach with a slight smile and finish with a frightening impact.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/1057b2bf42b575e449c027a99eae90d86a099cfb.png"][/img][/p][h3]🌹Queen of the Wilderness X: Alluring Seahorse Blaster "Sea Heart Blaster"[/h3][p]"A dress dazzling more than the sunlight, a presence shining brighter than a gun."[/p][p]Just the sight of her walking across the battlefield draws attention, but the moment she fires a shot, all enemies tense up.[/p][p][/p][p]"The charm of the sea meets the sweetness of the heart seahorse. It's cute, but the current of the water is harsher than expected!"[/p][p]This blaster, combining a sweet heart design with powerful water pressure, combines beauty and power.[/p][p][/p][p]💘Matching Point:[/p][p]Fatal beauty and precise movements.[/p][p]A stylish combination that achieves both perfection in both appearance and performance.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/e304100daf0263d616a8ef56e5838f2bc6e6620f.png"][/img][/p][h3]👮 Beach Watcher x Octoshooter, a ranged crossbow with a shining octopus design[/h3][p]"A beach watcher with a whistle. There's never an accident in the waves he protects."[/p][p]When he hears the sound of waves and a whistle, he quickly establishes order.[/p][p][/p][p]"A crossbow with an octopus wrapped around it. One shot and the whole beach gets wet!"[/p][p]This combination, with their sharp observation and precise judgment, are the center of the team.[/p][p]They control the flow of the battlefield with the Octopus Crossbow, which covers a wide area with a single step.[/p][p][/p][p]🐙 Key Combination:[/p][p]Situational Awareness → Wide Area Domination[/p][p]A strategic combination that maintains balance on the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/b4b14a854671597ab3fb6965d8f3abbadcaa8362.png"][/img][/p][h3]🏖 Child Explorer of the Sea x Star-patterned Dolphin Squirt, "Star Dolphin"[/h3][p]"A girl searching for treasure in the sea. She plays tricks with the waves, but she also doesn't shy away from threats in the sand."[/p][p]An agile fighter that dances like a dancer on the sand.[/p][p]When paired with the light and fast Squirt, she sets the rhythm of the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][p]"The star-patterned Dolphin Spout. A cute rapid-fire gun that sparkles on the waves!"[/p][p]The Dolphin Spout's high-fire rate is perfect for disrupting enemies with quick decisions and movements.[/p][p][/p][p]🐬 Key Combination:[/p][p]Sharpen the battlefield with agility and rapid-fire power.[/p][p]A shock-type combination centered on speed and mobility.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]☀️ SUMMER HAZE, which combination will you use to dominate the summer?[/p][p]It's time to choose.[/p][p]Each summer-exclusive combination boasts its own unique personality, style, and combat acumen.[/p][p]Color the summer battlefield with your own style! 🌊🔥[/p][p][/p][p]That's all for today's introduction.[/p][p]See you again soon with a new story.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [WILD WEST: THE LAST COWBOY] Character & Gun Skin Combination Introduction Part2

Justice is slow, but his gun always strikes true."[/p][p][/p][p]Weapon Skin: Cold Ranger[/p][p]"Faster than the horse, he arrives before the law."[/p][p]The secretive and deadly "Cold Ranger" suddenly appears in the silence and organizes the battlefield in a single, deadly room.[/p][p]Featuring an old-fashioned silver color and a clean silhouette, its strengths are its quick aiming and accuracy.[/p][p][/p][p]Recommended for:[/p][p]A player who carefully seeks opportunities[/p][p]A player who is confident in their distance control and accurate shots[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/5f391f2d7dbcc08015dfddd3a9c06d159d1fb9aa.png"][/img][/p][p]Queen of the Wilderness, the embodiment of speed[/p][p]Judgment faster than the eye + Declaration[/p][p]"A horse faster than a gun, and a gaze hotter than a sandstorm."[/p][p][/p][p]Weapon Skin: Sunforged[/p][p]"A legendary firearm forged under the sun in the sandy wind."[/p][p]Sunforged boasts a sun-hot color and rapid-fire power, perfectly supporting Ruby's fast-paced combat style.[/p][p]The engraved golden pattern and flaming bullet effect make combat even more impressive.[/p][p][/p][p]Recommended Players[/p][p]A style that pursues speed and elegance[/p][p]For players who want to dominate enemies with quick reactions in close-range combat[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/29582238c28813823a8e1d2214f191907df951af.png"][/img][/p][p]A firm step, the power to dominate the battlefield[/p][p]Wilderness Strike + Fleur-de-Lys[/p][p]"A warrior noble, lily-inspired appearance and a heavy, powerful weapon.[/p][p]Although the burst rate is slow, this skin is powerful enough to instantly dominate enemies with a single hit.[/p][p][/p][p]Recommended for:[/p][p]Players who prioritize single-room power and accuracy[/p][p]A defensive style that calms future enemies[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/a976a52eb667604e819c05cdbc9d38f5b9971a0e.png"][/img][/p][p]Small but powerful presence[/p][p]Master of Surprise + Sunforged[/p][p]"Born to smell gold. Small, but larger than anyone underground."[/p][p][/p][p]Weapon Skin: Sunforged[/p][p]With its explosive movements, Sunforged perfectly reflects Dipdick's fighting style.[/p][p]Optimized for maximum damage in a short amount of time, it pairs well with the erratic movements of a grave robber.[/p][p][/p][p]Recommended Players[/p][p]Users who excel at quick evasions and surprise attacks[/p][p]Users who want to confuse their enemies with unpredictable patterns[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/2f9e4f83c3d5f8d2ad950320e84a1732507e6d32.png"][/img][/p][p]Cold Ranger[/p][p]"A gunshot faster than a horse, arriving before the law. The last ranger of the West, moving in silence."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/2f1ac836b60a72002052abc8fd57b5f708ae8bba.png"][/img][/p][p]Sunforged[/p][p]"A legendary firearm forged in the sun and through the sand. A room more precious than gold, hotter than the sun."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/85fae16cec833b10af5092bd7f8d3535f121321b.png"][/img][/p][p]Fleur-de-Lys[/p][p]"A vestige of nobility left on the Western frontier. A room where nobility prevails, and justice blooms like the lily."[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🐎 Complete your legend with your own unique combination[/p][p]The choice is yours.[/p][p]By combining characters and firearms that reflect your individual philosophy and fighting style,[/p][p]become the legend of the wilderness, the last cowboy.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all for today's introduction.[/p][p]See you soon with a new story.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: [WILD WEST: THE LAST COWBOY] Maps Introduction!!!🐎
notes.content: [p]Hello, gunslingers![/p][p]Expand the vast Wild West battlefield! A serious battle of skill and strategy unfolds across three maps![/p][p]Today, we're introducing three maps from WILD WEST.[/p][p][/p][p]This isn't just a simple Wild West shooting game; it's a true Wild West battlefield where skill, strategy, and teamwork come together perfectly.[/p][p]Now, let's introduce the three battlefields that lie beneath your boots.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/36b768d5d0dacda2cd696b171cb20d3b2e278f74.png"][/img]🌵 1. Western Village – A battlefield where only the strongest survive[/h3][h3]A sun-drenched, dry, and obstacle-free twin town[/h3][p]Western Village is a classic battlefield without any devices or obstacles, where victory is determined solely by the player's skill and reaction time.[/p][p][/p][p]It features fast-paced action and fast-paced combat, making it the most popular map for confident players.[/p][p]There's no hiding or excuses here. You have to jump and fight.[/p][p]If you want to experience the "world of a true gunfighter," this is the place for you.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/1498ba9f286ca348275db8380acda94bbf78d143.png"][/img]🔥 2. Red Desert – A battlefield where tactics reign[/h3][h3]At the end of the desert, a fallen carriage lies on the red ground at dusk.[/h3][p]Red Desert is a tactical battlefield where victory isn't just down to skill, but also positioning and character combinations.[/p][p][/p][p]The core of this map is psychological warfare utilizing detritus and manned tactics, as well as cooperative multiplayer battles unfolding at various combat points.[/p][p]More important than individual numbers are strategic positioning and team chemistry.[/p][p]What kind of team is your team? Red Desert will test your answer.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/db7d3f00a703cf0810ccaa0cfd4bcb142aead4db.png"][/img]🪨 3. Mine - A Dark, Strategic Maze[/h3][h3]Bright, stalkless mines, collapsed railroads, steep cliffs[/h3][p]The mines map is where the most complex and strategic battles take place.[/p][p][/p][p]Many obstacles create unpredictable combat situations, creating countless variables such as surprise attacks, evasions, and unannounced captures.[/p][p]Amid the chaos of surprise attacks, ambushes, escapes, and lures, one wrong move can quickly make you the target of an ambush.[/p][p]Every moment counts, and your choices will quickly determine your fate. Are you ready to dominate the mines?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Where will your battlefield be?[/p][p]The Western Village for the powerful, the Red Desert for the tactician, or the Mine for the strategist?[/p][p]One step, one choice, one battlefield could make you a legend.[/p][p][/p][p]Before answering the question, "Which character will you choose?"[/p][p]Perhaps we should start with the question, "What map will you fight on?"[/p][p][/p][p]Jump into the battlefield now in WILD WEST: THE LAST COWBOY.[/p][p]Conquer the West in your own style.[/p][p][/p][p]That's it for today, see you again soon with a new story. Thank you. :)[/p]

notes.title: [WILD WEST: THE LAST COWBOY] Character introduction #1!!!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Musketeers![/p][p]It's time to delve deeper into the charms of each character! Today is the first installment.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll introduce the stories of four legends who stir up the wilderness.[/p][p]The last battlefield of the Wild West, where gunfire and dust mingle.[/p][p]In "WILD WEST: THE LAST COWBOY," four characters appear, each with their own unique personality and fighting style.[/p][p][/p][p]Who will rule the wilderness with you in this game, where victory is determined not by mere shots but by strategy and combinations?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/137d0bf4b2876635070998b161e0004d8fe25b3c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Colter Maxwell[/b][/h3][h3]"His gun fires without warning. Judge of those with no law and no luck."[/h3][p]Colter Maxwell is a gunslinger and righteous outlaw renowned throughout the Wild West.[/p][p]He's a quintessential dealer character with well-balanced abilities, able to accurately target his enemies' weaknesses with his quick hands and cool-headed judgment.[/p][p][/p][h3]Red Revolver: A weapon for the cold-hearted duelist of the Red desert.[/h3][h3]Speaker: Fast[/h3][h3]Damage: Normal[/h3][h3]Movement Speed: Normal[/h3][h3]Health: Normal[/h3][p][/p][p]Redbone Revolver loads in six-round increments, and its faster fire rate makes it more effective in melee combat.[/p][p]Colter, who is effective in both all-out combat and ambush situations, is a beloved character for beginners and veterans alike.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/ebf40821413f87d288387f5f7d95c57c2d10cdd0.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Cash Jane[/b][/h3][h3]"Hotter than the sun, faster than the trigger. Where she rides, peace follows."[/h3][p]A female gunfighter living independently in the vast, rugged West, Cathy Jane is a sniper renowned for her quick feet and accurate shots.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ash Heart Revolver: Cold to the touch, but forged for a heart that still burns.[/h3][h3]Speaker: Slow[/h3][h3]Damage: High[/h3][h3]Movement Speed: Fast[/h3][h3]Health: Low[/h3][p][/p][p]Ash Heart revolver is similar in construction to the Redbone, but its dealing ability is far more powerful. Its slower firing rate makes precise aim and timing essential. This character is perfect for players who enjoy excellent mobility, the ability to quickly avoid enemy attacks, and the ability to take advantageous positions first. Each shot delivers a powerful, impactful impact.[/p][p][/p][p]The Cash Jane costume allows you to control the battlefield and enjoy the thrill of a sniper.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/f902075e3243d9c951a0994904959ff96922a22b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Bill Howard[/b][/h3][h3]"A warrior of the wild. He moves without a sound, leaving no trace."[/h3][p]Bill, the Indian warrior, dominates the battlefield with his heavy feet and powerful stamina. He is a tanker character with overwhelming survivability and a powerful weapon.[/p][p][/p][h3]Desert Bind: A great warrior’s crossbow, its grip and straps rich with history.[/h3][h3]Speaker: Slow[/h3][h3]Damage: High[/h3][h3]Movement Speed: Slow[/h3][h3]Stamina: High[/h3][p][/p][p]The Desert Bind is a weapon that must be reloaded one shot at a time, but its power is by no means light.[/p][p]Although it has low mobility, its stamina, which allows it to withstand enemy attacks, is the highest of all characters.[/p][p]It acts as a shield for allies, serving as a forward fortress and an important central axis in team play.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're a leader who wants to protect your team from the front, Bill is your best choice.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/3f46883835e2e1058e0af44c902612352c887567.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Leonard Jack[/b][/h3][h3]"Small, but digs deeper than anyone. Treasure may hide—but not from her."[/h3][p]A battlefield variable hidden within her small, swift silhouette, Leonard is a highly strategic character, despite her appearance.[/p][p][/p][h3]Duskstar: A Mauser that shines like a star in the darkest dusk.[/h3][h3]Speaker: Fast[/h3][h3]Damage: Weak[/h3][h3]Movement Speed: Normal[/h3][h3]Health: Normal[/h3][p][/p][p]Duskstar is a multi-shot automatic pistol with a fast fire rate and large magazine capacity, but relatively low damage.[/p][p]However, its extremely fast reload speed makes it extremely advantageous for continuously harassing the enemy and disrupting their rhythm.[/p][p][/p][p]This character's abilities vary greatly depending on the player, so players who enjoy chaotic, mobile, and fast-paced gameplay will have a lot of fun.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🔥The choice is yours now.[/p][p]Colter Maxwell, a referee who constantly attacks enemies with rapid fire[/p][p]Cash Jane, a powerful, fast-moving cowgirl[/p][p]Bill Howard, an Indian warrior with high stamina and a powerful leg[/p][p]Leonard Jack, a miner who presses with rapid reloads and rapid fire.[/p][p][/p][p]Choose one of these four warriors and walk the wilderness with your own fighting style.[/p][p]You are the gunslinger who will become a legendary Western legend.[/p][p][/p][p]That concludes today's introduction. I hope to see you again soon with a new story. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Wild West: The Last Cowboy New Update!
notes.content: [p]Howdy, gunmen![/p][p]"The Wild West" development team 😁[/p][p][/p][p]I've brought you a new update![/p][p][/p][p]Strengthen Rank AI Matching & Custom Team Features![/p][p]In this update, we have improved matching of rank battles and even further upgraded team features in custom mode. Strategic play is easier, and the wait is less! ⚔️[/p][p][/p][p]🎯 Automatic AI matching in case of rank match failure![/p][p]Now, if rank matching fails, it automatically matches with AI after a certain period of time and can start playing immediately.[/p][p]If you're tired of waiting to match, don't miss practice or score anymore![/p][p][/p][p]👥 Custom Mode – Team Change Added![/p][p]You can freely move to the team you want in the waiting room.[/p][p]It's more fun to strategically form a team or play in a team like a friend.[/p][p][/p][p]🎨 Improvement of UI for displaying the waiting room team[/p][p]The player list shows the team color and name, so you can see at a glance who is which team.[/p][p]It's especially useful in a mode where team play is important![/p][p][/p][p]👁 Extension of viewing mode (2:2/3:3 mode included)[/p][p]Now you can watch it in 2:2/3:3 mode![/p][p]Even if you don't play it yourself, you can watch your friends' games.[/p][p][/p][p]🛠 Fix bugs[/p][p]I corrected the phenomenon that the UI went wrong when the mode selection button was pressed when creating a custom room.[/p][p]Stabilized the UI to no longer twist with button clicks.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to improve our playing environment in the future.[/p][p]Opinions are always welcome! 💬[/p]

notes.title: Wild West: The Last Cowboy Update Announcement
notes.content:
Howdy, Gunslingers!
This is the Wild West Development Team 🤠

We’ve got some exciting updates for you today!

🎯 Russian Roulette Mode
We’ve been working intensively on this brand-new mode for over a month!
An extreme PvP mode where mind games and luck collide is finally here.

🎓 Tutorial Improvements
We’ve added guide animations to help new players get started more smoothly.
The tutorial is now more detailed, helping players naturally learn how to shoot and understand the game flow.
In particular, we’ve added a duel section against NPCs so you can build up your real combat instincts.

🗺️ Map Structure Improvements
We’ve fine-tuned the lighting colors and restructured object placements.
The environment now feels more authentic to the Wild West and much more lively, with clearer movement paths.

🕹️ VR Movement Enhancements
We’ve refined player movement synchronization in VR,
making actions look much more natural to other players.

notes.title: Wild West: The Last Cowboy is Now Officially Released!
notes.content:
Howdy, Cowboys! 🤠 We're officially live!

We’re super excited to announce that Wild West: The Last Cowboy is now available on Steam!
It’s time to saddle up, draw your revolver, and dive headfirst into the action-packed world of the Wild West.

This isn’t just another shooter. It’s a full-blown VR multiplayer action experience where every shooting duel feels personal and every win takes you one step closer to becoming the ultimate cowboy legend.

In Wild West: The Last Cowboy, you’ll face off in 1v1 real-time multiplayer showdowns, test your reflexes in fast draw duels, and roam through immersive Western towns full of dust, danger, and drama.
Whether you're hunting for glory on the leaderboards or just having fun outdrawing your friends, there’s something here for every gunslinger.

We’ve poured our hearts into capturing the spirit of the Wild West—the thrill, the grit, and of course, the unforgettable cowboys who shaped it. And now, we can’t wait for YOU to write your own legend.

🔫 Features:

Real-time 1v1 multiplayer gunfights

Fast draw ranking battles that test speed and precision

Beautifully crafted Wild West environments

Immersive VR shooting mechanics that feel real

And yes, you can wear the hat (figuratively... or literally)

This is just the beginning—we’d love to hear what you think, so drop your thoughts, share your best duels, and let’s build a real cowboy community together!

See you in the streets, partner. And remember: in the Wild West, only the quickest survive.
